title: Describing People and Places
description: Order words, adjectives and prepositional phrases to write vivid descriptions of people and settings.

thumbnail.alt: An artist sketchbook and colored drawing pencils showing miniature sketches of cozy city buildings
thumbnail.prompt: An artist sketchbook and colored drawing pencils showing miniature sketches of cozy city buildings. Flat vector illustration, soft warm earthy palette (terracotta, sage green, ochre, muted blue, cream) with a small touch of muted gold, very subtle, even paper grain, simple rounded shapes, gentle soft lighting, centered composition with generous empty space around the subject, mid-tone background that works on both dark and light pages. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no real or famous people, no watermark. Full-bleed flat background color from edge to edge: no frame, no border, no round or oval vignette, no wreath, no mandala or ornament in the middle of the image. aspect ratio 16:10

items.sentence: She has long dark curly hair.
items.translation: Ela tem cabelo comprido, escuro e cacheado.

items.sentence: There is a quiet park near our school.
items.translation: Há um parque tranquilo perto da nossa escola.

items.sentence: My new teacher is extremely smart and helpful.
items.translation: Minha nova professora é extremamente inteligente e prestativa.

items.sentence: We live in a small modern apartment.
items.translation: Nós moramos em um apartamento pequeno e moderno.

items.sentence: The blue sky was full of white clouds.
items.translation: O céu azul estava cheio de nuvens brancas.

items.sentence: He wore a comfortable brown leather jacket.
items.translation: Ele vestiu uma jaqueta de couro marrom confortável.

items.sentence: That old library has thousands of fascinating books.
items.translation: Aquela biblioteca antiga tem milhares de livros fascinantes.
